questions.stem: Which of the following statements about non-competitive inhibition is correct?

options.text: Increasing substrate concentration will overcome the inhibition
Increasing substrate concentration will NOT overcome the inhibition
The inhibitor has a similar shape to the substrate
The inhibitor binds to the active site

questions.explanation: Non-competitive inhibition cannot be overcome by increasing substrate concentration because the inhibitor does not compete with the substrate for the active site. It binds elsewhere and changes the active site shape.
